result:
I've made the round-257 fix-up and C-R256-01 should now be closed; there is no STOP. This is not a pass: C still has to check it in the browser before stage 1 counts as done. All changes stay inside the 7 granted files, HEAD is still `a061d52`, and `git status` still lists the same 14 paths. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed**
- **The fix:** Play and Stop now carry a shared description, "Playing" or "Stopped". It comes from one hidden element in the centre group. Names, titles, `aria-keyshortcuts`, classes and handlers are unchanged; the source change matches B's sketch exactly. The two new strings sit in `strings.ts` and in the ST10 expected list.
- **C-R256-02:** the three cleanup Stop clicks in `render-budget` now check `data-playing` before (`true`) and after (`false`).
- **Tests:** GS14 gets a new title. TC10 and TC11 are new, and TC11 also checks that nothing else on the page points at the hidden element.
- **Doc 193:** the status line is exact, with one Problem → Solution bullet, one testing bullet, and one changed-files line.

**Checks run**
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass. Biome reports nothing on my files.
- The 15 covering test files pass: 243 tests. The slowest is NS5 at 26 % of its timeout. I checked every file's timeout.
- **Mutants:**
  - M6, M7 and M8 each go red.
  - M9 turns 5 render-budget tests red, including all three cleanup tests. One first-red line differs from B's prediction: at the l.472 site it is the existing l.462 check, because that test clicks Stop once earlier.
  - I added M9b, where Stop works only on its first click, which makes each of the three new after-click lines fail on its own (l.350, l.375, l.478).
- **Chromium on :5173, both viewports:**
  - The descriptions read Stopped / Playing / Stopped after Stop / Playing after Space / Stopped after a double-click on Stop, for both buttons.
  - The toolbar is 49 px at 1440 and 87 px at 1280, the same as round 256.
  - The hidden element has no box and cannot take focus, and there were no page errors.
  - The first browser attempt timed out waiting for the page to load. A check right after showed it ready, and the re-run passed.
- **End checks:** all start-state hashes (frozen tree, carried, root and protected files) still match. The L50 grep gives the same 2 hits as before.

**Code review**
The code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with no Medium or higher findings. I fixed its one Low by making TC11 require `hidden` to be exactly empty. A variant using `hidden="until-found"` stays green, because React 18.3.1 renders `hidden` as a plain boolean attribute; I recorded it as an equivalent mutant.

**For B**
- **Architecture note:** Play/Stop semantics changed in rounds 249, 256 and 257, and each time 9–10 test files had to follow. The reviewer proposes one bounded task that makes a single test file own the transport's a11y contract, bundled with the backlogged `role="group"` item. I made no structural change.
- **Doc 193, two lines outside this round's grant:** the round-256 "six tests" line may read as conflicting with the new "five tests" line, and the approach bullet doesn't mention the new description.

**Not run** (gate or C rows): the full suite, `verify`, build, e2e smoke, the WAV export, and the remaining C browser rows (C-FOCUS, C-KEYS, C-LAYOUT, C-BUDGET, LAB-SMOKE, Auth). C's next checks are listed in §10 of the report.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-257.md`; logs, the probe script and screenshots are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-257/`.
